name: csv-analyst
title: CSV analyst
summary: Answers questions about a folder of CSVs by writing SQL against them.
blurb: Every CSV mounted at data/ is loaded into an in-memory SQLite database, one table per file, and the agent writes a SELECT to answer your question — so joins across files work and the arithmetic is done by a database rather than by a language model. It ships with a sample dataset; mount your own alongside it and they compose, because a repeatable --mount adds to what the bundle carries instead of replacing it.

input.question: Which region had the highest revenue after discounts, and what was the gross margin on it?
